storylines.title: Prologue: The Leaf and the Fire
storylines.about: Virginia, 2767, told by the King in Rome. The Free Assembly rises against Church and Crown, and begins with fire.

still.caption: The plantation in Virginia: the drying barns, the manor on its rise, the oak where Tomasz reads.

lines: My ship to Rome sails at the end of the month. Until then I read, and I help the chaplain.
The men in the fields talk of an Assembly. I do not understand what they want.
I still smell the smoke when I close my eyes.
Two letters came for the Governor: one from an explorer of the deep earth, one from a clockmaker. He gave them to me to read.
The harvest is in the barns. A fortune hangs in those rafters, and every rebel in the county knows it.
Study the war table. Then we wait for the night.
It is done. I take no pleasure in it.
Ruggieri has his pipe, and I have the King's leaf. Rome will hear of this.

storylines.title: The Explorer
storylines.about: A Catholic explorer goes down into the deep earth and finds the Brood. (Being written.)

still.caption: A ship's cabin lit by a lantern: charts of caverns, a crucifix, a cage of strange eggs.

storylines.title: The Clockmaker
storylines.about: A clockmaker grows afraid of his own Clockwork. (Being written.)

still.caption: A workshop of gears and springs; a half-built Clock Soldier on the bench, a priest at the door.
